contract: policy DATA only — never executable logic. Every entry states its semantic purpose. Entries must NOT be added to fix a single evaluation item.
e4b_rule: exact-one type match is NECESSARY SUPPORTING evidence, NEVER SUFFICIENT identity evidence. E4b additionally requires: candidate in a STRICTLY PRIOR sentence; no competing unnamed party introduced by an indefinite marker before the target; exactly one survivor. Otherwise AMBIGUOUS or EXTERNAL_UNRESOLVED.

company.purpose: generic party reference; the document does not constitute a company

vendor.purpose: third party contracted by the document's subject; exists independently of the document

overlap_note: type_noun and external_party answer DIFFERENT questions and legitimately overlap. 'company' is a type_noun (it may anaphorically reference a named Organization) AND an external_party (if unresolved, never manufacture a document-constituted entity). Order: resolve antecedence first; only if that fails does external_party apply.
owner: DISCOURSE-REFERENCE-V1 and its frozen fixture suite

company.purpose: anaphoric type-noun for a named organization

document.purpose: anaphoric type-noun for a named document

person.purpose: anaphoric type-noun for a named person

product.purpose: anaphoric type-noun for a named product

service.purpose: anaphoric type-noun for a deployed technical service

vendor.purpose: party type-noun; also EXTERNAL_PARTY - see overlap note
